_comment: Who said it. Each quote is copied from the King James text of the verse
given, word for word, and the check refuses any it cannot find there —
so a misremembered line fails loudly instead of contradicting its own
reveal. Punctuation and capitals do not matter to the check; words do.
Only spoken words, and only where one person unmistakably said them. A
line two people said together, or one Jesus also said, makes a round where
a wrong answer is arguably right. Never let the quote contain the
speaker's own name — the check refuses that too.
difficulty is how well known the line is, not how hard it is to parse.
